title: One person’s way through The Labs, left to right
dek: The region chart shows the parts. This map follows one participant from first hearing of us to after a Cycle, with what people told us at every step.
cover_alt: The participant journey: ten steps on one blue line, from hearing of The Labs to after a Cycle, a strip above showing where the Cycle opens up and narrows at each vote, red rings where people leave, and quotes from alumni and organizers under each step.
